review:
Ze Zeus meets the Le Zeus reveal mechanic. Wonder symbols drop down reels 2 to 5 and reveal high symbols, wilds or full Wonder Reels, and any win with revealed symbols triggers sticky respins.

Wonder Reels hold coins, diamonds, clovers and Pots of Olympus that gather everything into one total. In the Godly Ascension bonus, a Wonder Meter fills towards reward spins on a full grid of Wonder symbols, with the minimum coin tier rising each time. That's where the 20,000x max comes in.
